titulo: Lokah Samastah Sukhino Bhavantu, on a Friday
caption:
Lokah Samastah Sukhino Bhavantu: may all beings, in all the worlds, be happy.
All of them. Yes, him too.
Link in bio.
by NMR
#lokahsamastahsukhinobhavantu #mantra #kindness

alt.1: green field, Cella saying “Even who?” in a speech bubble. Lokah Samastah Sukhino Bhavantu. A wish for everyone. Even him. Four words. Each one harder than it looks.
alt.2: amber field, Cella next to an office table saying “Even here?”. Lokah: all the worlds. Every world. Yes, also the office on a Monday.
alt.3: pink field, Cella saying “Him too?!”. Samastah: all beings, every single one. All beings. Even the guy who reclined his seat into you.
alt.4: yellow field, Cella with her eyes shut next to a sofa, saying “Just… happy?”. Sukhino: happy. Happy. Not productive. Not optimized. Happy.
alt.5: blue field, a pale yellow Cella next to a phone, saying “May they. Ugh. OK.”. Bhavantu: may they be: a wish, not an order. Your coworker got the promotion. Wish them well. Out loud.
alt.6: the four words as a list. May all beings everywhere be happy: Send it to the person you’d least include. Then include them. 1. Lokah · every world, office too. 2. Samastah · every being. Him. 3. Sukhino · happy, not productive. 4. Bhavantu · may they. Even the coworker.
